hints.text:
In order to keep score of the apples, you need "Collected" and "Missed" variables.
These variables should be set to 0 when starting the project to avoid confusion.
hints.title: Variables

hints.text: Set the initial placement so that the apples fall from the apple tree and are of the correct size.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text: We program the apples to fall down, and to make it more realistic, we make the apples rotate.
hints.title: Falling apples

hints.text: Within a "repeat forever" command, create a condition check for missing the basket.
hints.title: Counting missed apples

hints.text:
Create a condition that checks if an apple makes it into the basket or not.
The condition should always be checked.
hints.title: Counting the apples that make it into the basket

presentation.text:
It's time to pick apples. They are already falling from the tree themselves.
There's a basket under the apple tree and you can find out how many apples have fallen into the basket, and how many missed it.
Let's program it.
presentation.title: Apple picking season

hints.text: When you click on the green flag, all the sprites take their starting positions.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text: Program the basket so that it can be controlled from the keyboard.
hints.title: Basket control

hints.text: Program the ball to always fall down
hints.title: Ball falling

hints.text: After reaching the bottom edge, the ball disappears and reappears at a random point at the top. Program that.
hints.title: Moving the ball up the screen

hints.text: Within a "repeat forever" command, create a condition check for the ball missing the basket.
hints.title: Counting missed balls

hints.text:
Create a condition that checks if a ball makes it into the basket or not.
The condition should always be checked.
hints.title: Counting the balls that make it into the basket

hints.text: Add a check and victory announcement.
hints.title: *Bonus: winning and losing

hints.text: The ball turns in a random direction and starts moving. If it reaches the right or left edge, it bounces off.
hints.title: *The ball moves in a random direction
*Bonus: modify the game as you see fit

presentation.text: Catch the ball 5 times. To do that, control the basket using the arrows on the keyboard.
presentation.title: Catch the balls
